test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Choose the sentence with no spelling error.

options.text: You will be here for seventy - two hours.
You will be heare for seventy - two hours.
You will be here for sventy - two hours.
You will be here for seventy - two huors.

solution:
The correct answer is "**You will be here for seventy-two hours.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Among the given options,** option 1 does not contain any error.**
 
• We should always hyphenate numbers when we are describing compound numbers between 21 and 99.
 
• A compound number is any number that consists of two words; for example, eighty-eight, twenty-two, forty-nine.
 
• "Hour" means a period of 60 minutes.(घंटा)
 
 
• Example: I will reach there in an hour.
 
 
 
• The spellings of the other mentioned words, i.e. "you," "will," "be," here" are also correct in option 1.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
